usage: atm-bd queues [-h] (--phase PHASE | --root ROOT) [--all] [--stack]
                     [--json] [--min-age MIN_AGE] [--state-file STATE_FILE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --phase PHASE         phase; the root comes from .atm-bd/phase-<phase>.toml
  --root ROOT           the phase root bead id
  --all                 also list not-ready beads with reasons
  --stack               also read the phase stack from GitHub
  --json                print newly dropped rows as one JSON object
  --min-age MIN_AGE     --json: minutes a row must be old to be reported
  --state-file STATE_FILE
